figurative_meaning_en: Neatness of speech; elegance of sentence structure; restraint in speaking
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথার বাঁধুনি শুনে সকলে মুগ্ধ হয়ে গেল।
ভালো লেখকের কথার বাঁধুনি সবসময় মনোহর।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone was captivated by the eloquence of his speech.
A good writer's binding of words is always captivating.
note: This idiom highlights the aesthetic and disciplined aspect of Bengali verbal expression.
